features.quote: Terminate early if the judge detects instability above threshold.

limits:
  max_agent_turns: 50
  max_tool_calls: 100
  max_test_runs: 25
  max_tokens_total: 120000
  max_wall_clock_minutes: 20
  max_file_edits: 80
  max_consecutive_failed_tool_calls: 8
features.justification_quote: Stress tests can create runaway loops. Use: max turn cap, max tool cap, repeated-command circuit breaker
